title: Exposing Finite-Depth, Finite-Shot Guarantees for Constrained Quantum Optimization via Fejér Filtering
summary: Constrained quantum optimization algorithms need quantitative guarantees that connect circuit resources to the probability of actually sampling feasible or optimal solutions in finitely many shots. We establish such a connection by exposing a positive sampling law in which mixer-driven exploration and spectral selection can be controlled separately.
